call.text: Inner Monologue is a new training and inference setup for audio language models that predicts time‑aligned text tokens before audio tokens, using text tokens as a per‑timestep prefix to the semantic token [MOSHI:1:c007]. It significantly improves the factuality and linguistic quality of generated speech [MOSHI:1:c007] and almost triples Moshi’s accuracy on spoken question‑answering benchmarks, markedly raising performance over prior work while only marginally increasing inference cost [MOSHI:5.5:c091].
